title: S2 Space Threat Fact Sheet
canonical: spaceforce.mil Article 4297159 (no file attached as of Sep 2026)
use: External impact context only: tie a ratee's work to the threat it counters (e.g. '...hardened SATCOM vs PLA EHF jamming'). Never claim the ratee changed these numbers. At run time, search for a newer edition and ask the user if they have one; cite the edition and date in research.md.
headline: China is the PACING CHALLENGE and is rapidly improving its space capabilities to TRACK & TARGET U.S. military forces.
China & Russia are pursuing a wide range of counterspace capabilities to DISRUPT & DEGRADE U.S. space capabilities.

metrics.fact: 42 launches by Jul 2025 (41 successful), placing 112 payloads in orbit; 19 (17%) were ISR-capable
on-orbit presence grew ~927% (+1,049 satellites) since end of 2015; 1,189+ satellites in orbit as of Jul 2025
510+ ISR-capable satellites (optical, multispectral, radar, RF) improving ability to detect U.S. carriers, expeditionary forces and air wings
90 G60 comm satellites launched toward 648 by end-2025 and 15,000 by 2030; China Satellite Network Group launched 67 since Aug 2024 toward 13,000
at least 10 on-orbit SSA satellites in LEO
space-based capabilities combined with standoff weapons enable long-range precision strikes against U.S. and allied forces
3 reusable spaceplane missions (2 days, 9+ months, ~9 months); all released unidentified objects
2007 DA-ASAT test created 2,700+ pieces of trackable debris; now an operational ground-based system the PLA trains on
DIA assesses the PLA probably intends ASAT weapons able to reach GEO (36,000 km); a 2013 ballistic object peaked at 30,000 km

SJ-21 and SJ-25 maneuvered into extremely close proximity in GEO for probable satellite refueling experiments; SJ-21 moved a derelict BeiDou satellite to a graveyard orbit (Jan 2022); SJ/TJS satellites perform large, rapid GEO maneuvers; 3 Shiyan-24 satellites conducted LEO proximity ops in 2024
multiple ground-based lasers able to disrupt, degrade or damage satellite sensors; higher-power systems possible by mid-to-late 2020s
PLA exercises routinely jam space-based comms, radars and GPS; may be developing jammers against SATCOM including U.S. protected EHF
17 launches in 2024, vs a 26+/yr average from 1995-2015; only 5 foreign payloads placed
Nov 2021 Nudol DA-ASAT test created 1,500 trackable debris pieces and tens of thousands of non-trackable objects, endangering the ISS and Tiangong

probable orbital ASAT prototypes deployed into LEO in 2017, 2019, 2022, 2024 and 2025; the four most recent in orbits matching U.S. national security satellites; one ejected an object near a Russian satellite while testing a space-based ASAT

3 satellites launched Feb 2025 made close approaches under 1 km; Jun 2025 a satellite in a peculiar high-altitude orbit passed near numerous U.S. and allied GEO satellites and released an object it repeatedly approaches
Peresvet lasers deployed to 5 strategic missile divisions since 2018 to blind satellite sensors; more powerful lasers possible by 2030
developing a satellite designed to carry a nuclear weapon, a threat to all satellites and space-enabled services; as of Apr 2025 a satellite believed tied to the program was tumbling

says 'quasi-civilian' commercial satellites may be legitimate targets; used cyber attacks on commercial space in Ukraine; in 2025 told regulators European satellites aiding Ukraine are 'legitimate targets'; ongoing GPS and SATCOM electronic attacks across Europe
continues testing space-based quantum key distribution toward a global ultra-secure comms network
reusable launch progress, incl. a 12 km vertical takeoff and landing test in 2024, key to its pLEO plans
a large missile seen on a MiG-31 in 2018 may be the Burevestnik air-launched ASAT
